elements.text: Your account, and how Overture works for you
On. Overture is searching and sending.
Pausing stops new applications from going out. Anything already sent stays sent, and replies keep arriving in your Inbox.
Overture applies only to postings whose Match score is at least this. 60 is the default; 50 sends to more postings.
At 60, a posting needs a Match score of 60 or more. A score of 80 or more is marked as a Strong match.
The same limits for everyone, so your applications arrive one at a time and never as a burst.
3 left today · resets at your local midnight
At most ten applications a day. The count starts again at your local midnight.
Applications go out only in daytime, your local time, at least 20 minutes apart.
After an application to a company, Overture waits 7 days before applying there again.
A role that is reposted is skipped for 60 days after you applied to it.
These limits are fixed. Nothing here can be turned up, down or off.
Week plan, 70 applications. Renews Tuesday 24 November.
You are charged only when an employer confirms it received an application.
An application that could not be sent uses nothing.
Yesterday's applications sent, replies, open Reviews and check-ins. Sent to maya.okafor@example.com.
A new Review, an employer reply, an interview or offer, a card moved for you, and when Overture pauses.
Your day, the 08:00 to 20:00 window and the midnight reset all follow this. A change takes effect after 7 days.
Overture only applies to postings written in these languages.
